about_the_game:
Crownless Duelist

Crownless Duelist is a multiplayer medieval dueling game that pits players against each other in intense 1v1 arena battles. Each match consists of up to 3 rounds, where tactical decisions play a crucial role.

At the start of each match, players are offered 3 randomly selected weapon types (such as swords, axes, spears, or bows). In addition, they must choose one of two special skills: one provides a buff to their own character, while the other applies a debuff to their opponent. These skills can only be used once per round and are refreshed at the start of each new round—capable of dramatically shifting the course of battle.

Crownless Duelist also includes a unique feature for Twitch and Kick streamers: during the weapon and skill selection phase, streamers can let their audience vote in chat to decide their loadout. This adds a new layer of viewer interaction and unpredictability to the fight.

In this arena where strategy, reflexes, and community involvement collide, victory belongs to the most cunning duelist.
